kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pastas (penne with Gorgonzola cream, Genovese with shrimp), fried blue crab and maitake fritters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cicchetti, prosciutto, pâté, cheese and seafood pastas (2026 reviews). Some vegetable plates (marinated purple cabbage, eggplant with balsamic), but no vegan menu is mentioned.
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Wed 15:00–24:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 23:30); Fri–Sun 15:00–1:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 0:30); 15:00–17:00 drinks and light snacks, then dinner and bar; light snacks only after 22:00. Closed Thursday and other irregular days — check the shop's Instagram. Reservations taken; dessert plates by phone; courses by the day before. Standing at the counter is free; tables carry a ¥400 seat charge at dinner — Tabelog, Japanese original 「スタンディングはチャージなし、テーブルはお席代400円」. 36 places: 20 standing, 16 at high tables. Non-smoking. Cards, e-money and QR. English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Children welcome.
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.notes: [Italian standing bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, a Venetian bacaro] A Venice-style bacaro near City Hall: stand at the front counter for cicchetti and a glass of wine from about ¥1,800, or take a high table for pasta, fritters and courses. Open from 3 pm to midnight or 1 am; English menu. ¥400 table charge, standing free. Closed Thursday.

roles: Operator: 株式会社HOTTA (NTA invoice registration at the shop address)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 November 2017 (Tabelog). 2026 reviewers describe a lively place, popular with diners in their 20s, used for girls' nights and birthdays, with attentive staff and an extensive wine list; weekday tables were nearly fully booked in August 2026 while the standing counter was quiet.
chef_bio.philosophy: Modeled on the bacari of Venice (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Cicchetti; pastas; Italian wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "I had researched beforehand and found this Italian place inspired by the bacari of Venice, which opens at 3:00 PM… Leaning against the counter while chatting casually with the staff and sipping beer was fantastic."
April 2026: "The marinated purple cabbage was especially delicious, so I ordered it twice. The wine selection was also extensive."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IL LAGO、イタリアン・立ち飲み・ワインバー、中京区河原町三条二筋上ル恵比須町534-29、地下鉄京都市役所前駅から徒歩2分、月〜水15:00〜24:00 (料理L.O.22:00、ドリンクL.O.23:30)、金〜日15:00〜翌1:00 (料理L.O.23:00、ドリンクL.O.0:30)、15:00〜17:00はドリンクと軽食、22時以降は軽食のみ、木曜と不定休 (Instagramで告知)、予約可、デザートプレートは電話で、原文で「スタンディングはチャージなし、テーブルはお席代400円」、36席 (立ち20・テーブル16)、禁煙 (外に灰皿)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、英語メニュー・英語対応スタッフ、子連れ可、2017年11月3日オープン。インボイス登録は株式会社HOTTA (店の住所、国税庁)。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): ヴェネツィアのバーカロ風の立ち飲みイタリアン、チケッティ盛り合わせ1,000円、グラスの赤ワイン800円、エビのジェノベーゼ、紫キャベツのマリネ、ペンネのゴルゴンゾーラクリーム、舞茸のフリット、生ハム、フルーツのカプレーゼ、ハウスワインはプリミティーヴォ、誕生日プレート、コース。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Standing counter is free; ¥400 per person at tables.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated August, September and October 2026.

kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sukiyaki simmered in a sweet secret sauce (warishita) that reviewers say comes from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui (April–May 2026 reviews); soy-based sauces normally contain wheat.
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an A5 Wagyu sukiyaki shop; egg yolk and cheese in the finishing rice (2026 reviews).
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon and Wed–Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00; closed Tuesday. Reservations taken. 12 seats: 8 at the counter and private rooms for 2 and 4 (sunken kotatsu seating per a 2026 review); private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay). Basement of the 祇園ファーストビル on the Shijo-dori approach to Yasaka Shrine, about a minute from the shrine. Opened 1 May 2026.
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.notes: [Wagyu sukiyaki · Gion by Yasaka Shrine, a basement counter] A new (May 2026) basement counter a minute from Yasaka Shrine serving one-person A5 Wagyu sukiyaki bubbling in a hot stone pot — about ¥4,700–5,300 for 120g — finished with cheesy stone-grilled rice. Open from noon. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2026 (Tabelog). The listing says each cut of Wagyu is chosen by a master connoisseur; a May 2026 reviewer calls the sauce a company secret, and an April 2026 reviewer says it comes from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui. Reviewers describe the staff cooking the sukiyaki for the diner. Operator not identified; one April 2026 review was written at a pre-opening tasting.
chef_bio.specialty: Stone-pot A5 Wagyu sukiyaki; cheese stone-grilled rice.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "The dipping sauce deserves special mention. Sourced from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui, its balance of sweetness and richness elevates the meat's flavor."
May 2026: "You don't have to worry about cooking it yourself; it's delicious right from the start… The secret sauce is a company secret."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和牛一乃音 WAGYU ICHINONE、すき焼き・牛料理、東山区祇園町北側281-1-1 祇園ファーストビル B1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月・水〜日・祝 12:00〜21:00、火曜休み、予約可、12席 (カウンター8席、2名・4名の個室)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2026年5月1日オープン、目利きが選ぶ和牛を石焼で。口コミ (2026年4月〜6月、英語、うち1件はプレオープン): 一人用の石焼すき焼き、A5ミスジまたはA5ロースを60g・120g・180gで、A5ミスジ120g 4,700円、A5ロース120g 5,300円、割り下は福井の老舗日本料理店のものとの記載、七味と山椒、締めはチーズの石焼ごはん (卵黄入り)、八坂神社から徒歩1分。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and small private rooms; staff cook the sukiyaki for you.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 1 May 2026) with reviews dated May and June 2026.

kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Kyoto oden shop whose menu runs to croquettes, ham and tenderloin cutlets, fried oysters, shrimp fry and fried sardines; oden includes chikuwa and other fish cakes (2023–2026 reviews). Ask about plain oden items such as daikon and egg — the broth was not described.
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi with egg and beef tendon, sashimi, cutlets (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30; closed Sunday; hours and closed days may change, so check before visiting. Reservations taken — a November 2024 reviewer says they are a must. No credit cards (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, 8 at tables. Non-smoking. In the ザ・マインビル, down the first alley north off Sueyoshi-cho east of Hanamikoji (November 2024 review). The shop moved here before December 2023.
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.notes: [Oden & obanzai · Gion north of Shijo, an alley counter] A cheerful 14-seat oden counter tucked down a Gion alley: light Kyoto oden at about ¥300 a piece, obanzai, cutlets and an oden-broth potato salad, or a ¥4,000 omakase course. Reasonable for Gion. Book ahead; no cards. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since January 2023 describe a homey oden and obanzai shop that relocated within Gion before December 2023, with a cheerful owner who sees guests off and prices well below the Gion norm. Criticism: two reviewers found the oden broth too light or not fully soaked into every item (February and November 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style oden; oden potato salad; fried small potatoes.

anecdotes.text: April 2025: "Oh, and I also ordered the oden potato salad as an extra! It was like egg salad but with the flavor of oden broth—simply exquisite! This is a must-order!"
December 2023: "This was my first visit since they relocated, and the oden was just as good as ever, cooked in a wonderfully flavorful broth."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 菜処 やすかわ、おでん・日本料理、東山区祇園町北側347-133 ザ・マインビル 1F、月〜土18:00〜23:30、日曜休み、営業時間・定休日は変更の可能性あり、予約可、カード不可、14席 (カウンター6・テーブル8)、禁煙。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年4月、英語): 移転後も変わらぬ京風のおでん (2023年12月)、大根・卵・こんにゃく・しらたき・ちくわ・がんも・牛すじ、1品300円で牛すじは少し高め (2026年4月)、おまかせコース4,000円 (おばんざい、刺身、おでん5品、揚げ物3品、ごはん1品、2025年4月)、おでんのポテトサラダ、だし巻き、小芋の揚げ物、コロッケ、ハムカツ、ヒレカツ、カキフライ、その場で握るおにぎり、まぐろのたたき、明るい店主、予約必須との声 (2024年11月)、だしが薄いとの声 (2024年2月・11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter shop; book ahead; no cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated January and April 2026.
